name: Employees' State Insurance Scheme (ESIC)
overview: A self-financed social security and health insurance scheme for Indian workers in the organised sector, providing medical care, cash benefits and other social security benefits to employees and their dependents.
objectives: Provide medical care to insured employees and dependents
Offer cash benefits during sickness, maternity and disability
Provide dependent benefits in case of employment-related death

benefits.title: Medical Benefit
benefits.description: Comprehensive medical care for the insured person and family

benefits.title: Cash Benefits
benefits.description: Sickness, maternity, disability and dependent benefits as per contribution

otherCriteria: Employees earning wages up to the prescribed ceiling, working in covered establishments

applicationProcess.description: Employer registers the establishment and employees under ESIC
Employee and employer contribute a percentage of wages monthly
Insured person receives ESIC pehchan card
Avail medical and cash benefits at ESIC facilities

faqs.question: Who is covered under ESIC?
faqs.answer: Employees earning wages up to the notified ceiling in ESIC-covered establishments.

faqs.question: What benefits are provided?
faqs.answer: Medical care, sickness benefit, maternity benefit, disability benefit and dependent benefit.

name: Weather Based Crop Insurance Scheme (WBCIS)

ministry.name: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
ministry.department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

overview: A crop insurance scheme that provides insurance protection to farmers against adverse weather conditions such as rainfall deficit, temperature and humidity that are deemed to adversely affect crop production.
objectives: Provide insurance against adverse weather conditions affecting crops
Mitigate financial hardship caused by weather-induced crop loss
Stabilise farm income during extreme weather events

benefits.title: Weather-Indexed Payout
benefits.description: Claim payout based on weather parameter deviations recorded at reference weather stations, without the need for individual crop-cutting assessment

otherCriteria: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, both loanee and non-loanee, where WBCIS is implemented in place of PMFBY

faqs.question: How is WBCIS different from PMFBY?
faqs.answer: WBCIS uses weather parameters as a proxy for crop loss instead of yield-based assessment.

faqs.question: Is this scheme available everywhere?
faqs.answer: It is implemented in select states/areas as notified in place of yield-based crop insurance.
